name: Breast Milk
description: Guidelines for traveling with breast milk in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Breast milk is allowed in carry-on bags in reasonable quantities and is exempt from the 3-1-1 limit. The child does not need to be present to carry breast milk.
conditions: Declare breast milk at the start of security screening.
Ice packs or gel packs used to cool breast milk are also allowed but must be frozen solid; if slushy/liquid, they are subject to standard liquids limits.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring breast milk on a plane?

travelTips: Declare breast milk at the start of security screening.

faq.question: Is breast milk allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Breast Milk is restricted in carry-on luggage. Breast milk is allowed in carry-on bags in reasonable quantities and is exempt from the 3-1-1 limit. The child does not need to be present to carry breast milk.

faq.question: Can you pack breast milk in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Breast Milk is allowed in checked bags.
